description: M32-gated full wallet portfolio scan. Discovers all SPL tokens in a Solana wallet, runs intelligence on top holdings, and returns per-token analysis with aggregate portfolio risk metrics. Requires the caller to hold 5,000,000+ M32 tokens (balance verified on-chain via X-Wallet-Address header). Free for qualifying holders. Returns 403 if insufficient M32.

wallet.description: Solana wallet address to scan for token holdings.

walletAddress.description: Your Solana wallet address. M32 balance is checked on-chain to verify you hold 5M+ M32.

name: scan_portfolio_m32
